(let [cols ["ip_country" "eur_amount" "has_fraudulent_dispute"]]
  (loop [cur nil agg {}]
    (let [r (dabstep.payments/read-page cur cols)
          a (reduce (fn [m row]
                      (let [c (nth row 0) amt (nth row 1) f (nth row 2)
                            old (get m c {"fraudulent_volume" 0.0 "total_volume" 0.0})]
                        (assoc m c {"fraudulent_volume" (+ (get old "fraudulent_volume") (if f amt 0.0))
                                    "total_volume" (+ (get old "total_volume") amt)})))
                    agg (get r "rows"))
          nxt (get r "next_cursor")]
      (if nxt
        (recur nxt a)
        (return {"countries" (map (fn [[c v]] (assoc v "ip_country" c)) a)})))))
